memo:
THIS TURN: Play Island and keep Mountain for turn 2. Hold the 1 blue open. At the end of P3's turn, just before our turn 2, cast Brainstorm to dig for Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Talisman of Creativity or Lightning Greaves. Put back the two cards we need least. Keep enough lands to make drops on turns 2-4, with at least 1 Mountain and 2 Islands. Lightning Bolt needs red, so it is offline this turn.

TARGET: Turn 2: Mountain, then Harmonic Prodigy ({1}{R}). Turn 3: Island, then Vivi Ornitier ({1}{U}{R}). Turn 4: fourth land, then Guttersnipe ({2}{R}) plus a 1-mana spell. Prodigy makes Vivi (a Wizard) and Guttersnipe (a Shaman) trigger twice. Missing pieces: Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, a rock (Sol Ring, Arcane Signet), and a counter (Counterspell, Arcane Denial).

WIN PATH: Vivi, Prodigy and Guttersnipe together deal 6 to each opponent per instant or sorcery, and 2 per other noncreature spell. Grow Vivi with cheap spells, tap her for X, then finish with Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot. Our clock is roughly turns 7-9. P2 can combo around turns 5-7, so slow P2.

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P1 > P3.
- P2: fastest clock (sacrifice loops, drains, edicts). Bolt their engine pieces.
- P1: clock around turns 6-8, and each of our spells amasses once Sauron is out. Remove Mauhúr or The Great Goblin. Sauron's ward needs a legendary sacrifice, so don't target him.
- P3: slow control. Leave them alone for now, but save a counter for Exsanguinate.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Lightning Bolt is earmarked, in order, for:
1. Pitiless Plunderer;
2. Blood Artist or Zulaport Cutthroat;
3. Sephiroth (3/3), before four deaths in one turn;
4. Mauhúr or The Great Goblin.
Don't feed P2 deaths: no chump blocks, and no mass kills while Sephiroth is out.

HOLD: Bolt for the targets above. Don't Bolt players early.

REPLAN IF:
- Brainstorm finds Sol Ring: on turn 2, cast Sol Ring off Island, then Prodigy with Mountain plus Sol Ring. Vivi can't come down on turn 2 because she needs both U and R. Cast Vivi on turn 3 with mana left over.
- An opponent lands Plunderer or Blood Artist: Bolt it at once.
- We miss our red source.

THIS TURN: Play Mountain. Cast Harmonic Prodigy ({1}{R}) with Island plus Mountain, exactly 2 mana. Tapping out is safe: each opponent has 1 land and no board. Keep Ponder, Bolt and Rift in hand.

TARGET: Turn 3: Island, then Vivi ({1}{U}{R}). Turn 4: Island, then Ponder: Prodigy doubles Vivi's trigger, so +2 counters and 2 damage to each opponent. Activate Vivi ({0}, no tap) for 2: 3 lands + 2 = 5. Cast Guttersnipe (3), then Bolt (1) or hold 2 for Rift. Missing: Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, Sol Ring or Arcane Signet or Talisman of Creativity, Counterspell or Arcane Denial.

WIN PATH: With Vivi, Prodigy and Guttersnipe out, each instant or sorcery deals 6 to each opponent (other noncreature spells deal 2). Grow Vivi, activate her, then finish with Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot. Our clock is turns 7-9; P2 can combo on turns 5-7.

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P1 > P3
- P2: sacrifice and drain loops, edicts, fastest clock. Bolt its engine pieces.
- P1: Army grows off our spells. Remove Mauhúr or The Great Goblin. Never target Sauron: we can't pay his ward, so the spell is countered.
- P3: slow control. Leave them alone; save a counter for Exsanguinate.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Bolt, in order: Pitiless Plunderer, then Blood Artist or Zulaport Cutthroat, then Sephiroth (before its fourth drain in a turn), then Mauhúr or The Great Goblin. Killing a creature while Sephiroth is out drains us 1. Single-target Rift: Grave Pact, Ashnod's Altar, The One Ring or Call of the Ring. No chump blocks.

HOLD: Bolt and Rift for those targets. Overload Rift ({6}{U}, 7 mana) only at an opponent's end step or on our winning turn. Don't Bolt players.

REPLAN IF:
- Prodigy dies: cast Vivi next turn anyway.
- P2 lands Plunderer, Blood Artist or Zulaport: Bolt it next turn, before Vivi if needed.
- We draw Sol Ring: next turn cast Sol Ring off Island, then Vivi with Mountain, Island and 1 from Sol Ring. The leftover colorless can't cast Bolt or Ponder.

THIS TURN: Play Sulfur Falls. It enters untapped because we control an Island. Cast Vivi ({1}{U}{R}) with all 3 lands, which taps us out. That is acceptable: P1 and P3 are tapped out. P2's High Market gives only 1 colourless, and Cabal Coffers makes nothing without {2} and Swamps. Keep Ponder, Bolt and Rift.

TARGET: Next turn, play Island (4 lands).
- Cast Ponder ({U}) first. Prodigy doubles Vivi's trigger, so she gets +2 counters (power 2) and deals 2 to each opponent.
- Activate Vivi for 2 and spend it with 1 land on Guttersnipe ({2}{R}).
- Leave Island plus 1 other land untapped for Rift on opponents' turns. Vivi's mana is gone after the phase.

Still missing: Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots; Sol Ring, Arcane Signet or Talisman of Creativity; Counterspell or Arcane Denial.

WIN PATH: With Vivi, Prodigy and Guttersnipe out, each instant or sorcery deals 6 to each opponent: 2 from the doubled Vivi trigger and 4 from the doubled Guttersnipe trigger. Grow Vivi, activate her, then finish with Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot. Our clock is about 4-5 more rounds; P2 could combo in 2-3.

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P1 > P3
- P2: sacrifice and drain loops plus edicts; fastest clock. Bolt its engine pieces.
- P1: its Army grows off our spells. Never target Sauron (ward we can't pay). Kill Mauhúr or The Great Goblin.
- P3: slow control. Y'shtola is 2/4, so Bolt can't kill it. Leave them alone for now.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Bolt in this order: Pitiless Plunderer, Blood Artist or Zulaport Cutthroat, Sephiroth (3/3, before its fourth drain in a turn), then Mauhúr or The Great Goblin. Use single-target Rift on Grave Pact, Ashnod's Altar, The One Ring, Call of the Ring, or an equipped Y'shtola. With Sephiroth out, each other creature that dies lets P2 drain someone 1. No chump blocks.

HOLD: Bolt and Rift for the targets above. Overload Rift ({6}{U}) only at an opponent's end step or on our winning turn. Don't Bolt players.

REPLAN IF:
- Vivi is removed: next turn cast Guttersnipe plus Ponder (4 mana), and recast Vivi later for 5.
- P2 lands Plunderer or Sephiroth: Bolt it next turn before Guttersnipe.
- We draw a counter: hold its mana instead of Rift mana.

THIS TURN:
1. Play Island.
2. Cast Vivi ({1}{U}{R}) with Island, Mountain and Island. She has never been cast, so there is no tax. If the cost shows 5, cast Guttersnipe instead.
3. Leave Sulfur Falls untapped for Bolt or Pongify. All three opponents are tapped out, so Vivi resolves.
4. Attack P2 with the Bird (2 flying). No one has a flyer to block it. Keep Prodigy home.

On opponents' turns, an instant still gives Vivi +2 and pings each opponent 2, because Prodigy doubles her trigger.
- If P2 casts Sephiroth or Pitiless Plunderer, Bolt it at once.
- If nothing else needed an answer, Bolt Ayara at P3's end step.

TARGET: Next turn, play the second Island (5 lands). Cast any cheap spell first to grow Vivi, then activate her. Use her mana plus lands for Guttersnipe ({2}{R}). Keep 1–2 lands open. Still missing: Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, Counterspell or Arcane Denial, Sol Ring or Arcane Signet, and Veyran.

WIN PATH: With Vivi, Prodigy and Guttersnipe out, each instant or sorcery deals 6 to each opponent. Grow Vivi, activate her, then finish with Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot. Our clock is about 4–5 rounds; P2 could combo in 2–3.

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P3 > P1
- P2: Ayara drains and draws, and Sephiroth loops are the fastest kill. Bolt its engine pieces; aim the Bird here.
- P3: Y'shtola (2/4, out of Bolt range) pings 2 per MV3+ spell, and P3 holds heavy removal. Pongify her only if she is equipped or draining hard.
- P1: no Sauron, only a 2/2 Army. Leave them alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Bolt, in this order: Plunderer, Sephiroth (3/3; kill it before its 4th drain, since the emblem survives), Blood Artist or Zulaport Cutthroat, then Ayara.
- Pongify: Y'shtola, Mauhúr, The Great Goblin, or Sephiroth if Bolt is gone.
- Never target Sauron (ward).
- With Sephiroth out, each other creature we kill drains us 1. No chump blocks.

HOLD: Sulfur Falls open for Bolt or Pongify. Don't Bolt players.

REPLAN IF:
- Vivi is removed: next turn, cast Guttersnipe plus an instant.
- Sephiroth lands: Bolt it immediately.
- We draw a counter: keep {U}{U} open.
- P3 equips Y'shtola: Pongify her.

THIS TURN (P3's turn, 1 open: Sulfur Falls):
- Hold Bolt. Fire it now only at Sephiroth, Pitiless Plunderer, Blood Artist or Zulaport Cutthroat if one lands.
- Our turn, in order:
  1. Play Island (5 lands).
  2. Cast Vivi ({1}{U}{R}); she has not been cast, so there is no tax.
  3. Cast Bolt on Braids with R. Vivi gets +2, and each opponent takes 2 from Vivi plus 4 from Guttersnipe.
  4. Activate Vivi for 2 U. Spend 1 on Pongify on Y'shtola (+2 Vivi, 6 more to each opponent).
  5. Keep the last land open.

TARGET: Vivi at 4+ power, with Prodigy and Guttersnipe, plus Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, and Counterspell or Arcane Denial kept up. Missing: Sol Ring, Veyran, Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will, Grapeshot.

WIN PATH: Each instant or sorcery deals about 6 to every opponent. Our turn line takes them to roughly 18/23/28. Then chain spells with Vivi's mana and finish with Crackle or Grapeshot in about 2-3 rounds. That is faster than P3's clock; P2 is the race risk.

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P3 > P1
- P2: Braids drains and edicts us, 7 cards in hand, Cabal Coffers, Sephiroth loops. Bolt Braids, and burn P2 first.
- P3: Y'shtola drains and holds heavy removal. Pongify her, and expect removal on Vivi.
- P1: Army only, no Sauron yet. Leave them alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Bolt: Braids, or Sephiroth/Plunderer if one lands first.
- Pongify: Y'shtola, or Sephiroth if Bolt is gone.
- Never target Sauron (ward).
- With Sephiroth out, killing creatures drains us: no chump blocks.
- Braids' end-step trigger: sacrifice nothing important; take the 2 life loss instead of losing Prodigy or Guttersnipe.

HOLD: One land after our main phase. Cast no spells on P1's turns beyond the plan, since each one grows his Army.

REPLAN IF:
- Vivi costs more than 3: cast her and hold Bolt and Pongify.
- Sephiroth hits the table: Bolt it now.
- A wipe hits: recast Vivi and burn.
- P1 casts Sauron: hold spells except the finishing turn.

THIS TURN (5 lands after Island; Vivi costs 3, no tax):
1. Play Island.
2. Cast Vivi with Mountain + Island + Island.
3. Pongify Y'shtola with Island. Prodigy doubles Vivi and Guttersnipe: Vivi +2 counters, 6 damage to each opponent.
4. Bolt Braids with Sulfur Falls: Vivi +2 (power 4), 6 more to each opponent.
5. Activate Vivi for 4 (U/U/R/R). This mana holds Negate this main phase only, against removal on Vivi or Prodigy (Snuff Out, Rollick). It empties before combat.
6. Attack P2 with Prodigy (3/5 after prowess) and Guttersnipe. P2 has no blockers after Braids dies.
7. Expected life: P1 18, P2 18, P3 28.

TARGET: Vivi 4+ alongside Prodigy and Guttersnipe, with Greaves or Boots and a counter up. Missing: Lightning Greaves, Swiftfoot Boots, Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will, Grapeshot, Veyran, Sol Ring.

WIN PATH: Each instant or sorcery deals 6 to every opponent, and Vivi's mana grows each turn. Three more spells kill P1 and P2, but that depends on what we draw (hand after this turn: Negate only). Crackle with Vivi's mana finishes. Clock about 2-3 turns, ahead of all opponents if Vivi survives.

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P1 > P3
- P2: 7 cards, Cabal Coffers, Sephiroth still to come. Burn and attack them first.
- P1: 5 mana; one land drop casts Sauron. Burn second, never target Sauron.
- P3: engine gone but removal-heavy. Leave them alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Sephiroth: next burn or bounce we draw. Don't chump or feed deaths.
- Y'shtola recast: next drawn removal.
- Sauron (ward): burn his controller out, not him. Once he is out, each spell we cast amasses his Army.
- Edicts: sacrifice nothing key; take the life loss.

HOLD: Negate for next turn, cast with Vivi's mana against a wipe or removal. No spare mana is open on opponents' turns.

REPLAN IF:
- Removal targets Vivi in main phase: Negate it (noncreature spells only). If she dies, still Bolt Braids, and recast her next turn for 5.
- Sephiroth lands first: Bolt it.
- A wipe resolves.

reason: executor escalation: P1: life 30→22 (-8); P2: life 35→27 (-8); P3: life 40→32 (-8)
memo:
THIS TURN:
1. Attack P2 with Harmonic Prodigy (3/5) and Guttersnipe (2/2). P2 has no creatures and no untapped mana, so nothing can block: P2 goes 27→22. Attack no one else, since P1's Army and P3's Y'shtola and Bird can block.
2. Second main: do NOT cast Vivi. Keep Island + Island + Mountain open.
3. On opponents' turns, Negate (Island + Island) a sweeper (Toxic Deluge, Blasphemous Act) or removal aimed at Guttersnipe or Prodigy.
4. Next turn: cast Vivi for 3 with Negate still up. Chain any drawn instants and sorceries, then activate Vivi.

TARGET: Vivi, Prodigy and Guttersnipe together. Each instant or sorcery then deals 6 to each opponent and each other noncreature spell deals 2. Missing: Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will, Grapeshot, Sol Ring, Counterspell.

WIN PATH: Guttersnipe plus Prodigy already deal 4 to each opponent per instant or sorcery. About 4 spells with Vivi out kill P1 (22) and P2 (22). Finish with an X spell paid by Vivi's mana. Clock is 2-3 turns. P1's Sauron and P3's drain are slower if we disrupt them.

THREAT ORDER: P1 > P3 > P2
- P1: 5 mana plus a land drop casts Sauron next turn, and every spell we cast then grows his Army. Burn them first; never target Sauron (ward).
- P3: Y'shtola's engine is live and they hold 5 cards of removal. Remove Y'shtola with the next burn or bounce we draw.
- P2: 7 cards but 3 lands and an empty board. Attack them freely now.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Wipe or noncreature removal: Negate.
- Y'shtola: next drawn Abrade, Fire Magic, Chaos Warp or Bolt-type card.
- Sauron: we have no answer; race him.
- Sephiroth (a creature, so Negate can't stop it): next burn we draw, before it reaches four deaths.
- Never chump block; P2 drains on every death.

HOLD: Negate and 2 blue mana through all opponents' turns. Keep Vivi in the command zone until she can land with a counter up.

REPLAN IF:
- Sauron resolves.
- A wipe resolves.
- We draw Greaves or Boots (then cast Vivi and equip).

THIS TURN:
1. Play Temple of Epiphany (it enters tapped). Scry: keep any instant, sorcery, counter, Greaves, Boots, Sol Ring or Windfall. Bottom a land.
2. Cast Vivi for 3 with Island + Island + Mountain. Opponents are tapped out except P3's 1 open land. Our hand is otherwise empty, so holding mana gains nothing.
3. Attack P1 with Guttersnipe (P1 20→18). Their Army and P3's Bird are tapped. Don't attack P2, whose untapped Marauder would block and trade.
4. Keep Sulfur Falls + Island open. We have nothing to cast with them.

TARGET: Vivi, Guttersnipe and Veyran (Prodigy is dead). Missing: Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, Jeska's Will, Windfall, Mizzix's Mastery, Crackle with Power, Grapeshot, Counterspell. Mastery's overload ({5}{R}{R}{R}) recasts Bolt, Pongify, Brainstorm, Ponder, Negate and Rift from our graveyard for free.

WIN PATH: Each instant or sorcery deals 3 to each opponent (Vivi 1, Guttersnipe 2). Other noncreature spells deal 1. Draw into a chain, and make Mizzix's Mastery or Jeska's Will the big turn. Our clock is about 3-4 turns. P1 can cast Sauron next turn with a land drop. The others are slower. Our life is 32 and no opponent threatens lethal.

THREAT ORDER: P1 > P2 > P3
- P1: 5 mana plus a land drop casts Sauron, and our spells then grow his Army. Burn and attack P1.
- P2: Cabal Coffers, 6 cards and repeated edicts. Sephiroth is in the command zone. If it's cast, burn it before it reaches four deaths.
- P3: Y'shtola is off the battlefield, they sit at 28, and they hold removal. Leave them alone, but remove Y'shtola if she's recast.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Sauron: we have no answer now. Race him and never target him (ward).
- Sephiroth: the first Abrade, Fire Magic or Bolt-type card we draw.
- Edicts: sacrifice Guttersnipe and keep Vivi.
- Never chump block, because P2 drains on deaths.

HOLD: Nothing in hand to hold. Leave the 2 open lands up.

REPLAN IF:
- Sauron resolves.
- Vivi is removed.
- A wipe resolves.
- We draw Greaves, Boots, Windfall or Mizzix's Mastery.

THIS TURN:
1. Cast Expressive Iteration with Island + Mountain (2 of 6 lands). It deals 3 to each opponent (Vivi 1, Guttersnipe 2), taking P1 to 13, P2 to 16 and P3 to 23. We lose 2 to Kambal (32→30). P1's Army amasses 1. Vivi becomes 1/4.
2. Play a land if one shows up in hand or exile. No land has been played this turn.
3. Cast cheap spells first (Snap, Probe, Opt, Consider). Then activate Vivi once for her power and spend that mana in the same phase, because it empties between steps.
4. Spend the mana in this order:
   - Swiftfoot Boots or Lightning Greaves, equipped to Vivi.
   - Abrade, Flame of Anor or Chaos Warp on Sephiroth.
   - An engine creature.
5. If we draw a counter, keep 2 open on opponents' turns (UU for Counterspell).
6. No attacks. Blockers kill Guttersnipe, and the death drains us through Sephiroth.

TARGET: Vivi (protected) + Guttersnipe + Veyran or Archmage Emeritus. Missing: Boots or Greaves, Counterspell, Windfall, Jeska's Will, Mizzix's Mastery (overload {5}{R}{R}{R} recasts Bolt, Pongify, Rift, Brainstorm, Ponder and Negate from our graveyard), Crackle with Power, Grapeshot. Flashback or Mystic Sanctuary can reuse Rift or Bolt.

WIN PATH: Each instant or sorcery deals 3 to each opponent, but costs us 2 to Kambal and grows the Army. Finish in one big turn: Jeska's Will or Mizzix's Mastery, closed with Grapeshot or Crackle. P1 falls first. Our clock is about 3 turns. No opponent has lethal on us next turn: 20 total power against our 30 life.

THREAT ORDER: P1 > P2 > P3
- P1: Sauron plus Army is 11+ power with Rogue's Passage, and Army hits wheel their hand. Race and burn P1. Never target Sauron: his ward needs a legendary sacrifice, which would be Vivi.
- P2: Sephiroth, 7 cards, Coffers. Four deaths in one turn gives a permanent emblem. Our first removal goes to Sephiroth.
- P3: Kambal taxes our chains. Abrade Kambal before a big chain. Otherwise leave P3 alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Sephiroth: Abrade, Flame of Anor or Chaos Warp. Bolt and Pongify are in the graveyard.
- Sauron: Blasphemous Act only if he is about to kill us, since it kills Vivi and feeds P2.
- Edicts: sacrifice Guttersnipe, never Vivi.
- Never chump block.
- Fire Magic only if a Marauder drain is acceptable.

HOLD: Save any counter for a wipe, Exsanguinate, Pitiless Plunderer, Ashnod's Altar or Grave Pact.

REPLAN IF:
- Sephiroth transforms or dies.
- Vivi dies.
- P1 wheels.
- We find Jeska's Will, Mastery, Windfall or Boots.
- Our life drops below 15.

THIS TURN: P2 has Nykthos untapped; P1 and P3 are tapped out. P1 (8 life, 21 power: Army 11/11 deathtouch, Sauron 7, Gothmog 3, Rogue's Passage) kills us next turn. Kill P1 now.
1. Cast Opt with Island. P1 goes to 5 (Vivi 1, Guttersnipe 2), we go to 11 (Kambal), and Vivi becomes 3/6. Keep any instant or sorcery on top. Bottom lands and permanents. Play a land if drawn.
2. Cast the drawn card before combat. Opt alone is not lethal. One more instant or sorcery puts P1 at 2, and the attack finishes P1. Cast all cheap spells, then activate Vivi (X = her power) and spend it the same phase. We have 5 lands left plus Vivi.
   - Snap on Gothmog, their only blocker. Snap untaps 2 lands.
   - Flashback on Bolt: 3 + 3 + 3.
   - Mizzix's Mastery ({3}{R}) on Bolt.
   - Crackle with Power, X=1 ({1}{R}{R}{R}).
3. Attack P1 with Vivi and Guttersnipe. Gothmog blocks one; the other finishes P1. P2's Feeder can't block.
4. If P1 still lives after combat: cast Blasphemous Act ({R} with 9 creatures out) or Chaos Warp the Army.

TARGET: P1 dead. Then Vivi and Guttersnipe with Veyran or Emeritus. Find Jeska's Will, Mastery, Grapeshot.

WIN PATH: P1 this turn. Then burn out P2 and P3 in about 3 turns.

THREAT ORDER: P1 > P2 > P3
- P1: lethal on us next turn. All damage goes at P1.
- P2: Sephiroth can be recast (6 cards, Coffers, Nykthos). Remove it on sight.
- P3: Kambal drains us 2 per noncreature spell. Leave P3 alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- P1's board: lethal this turn, or else Act or Chaos Warp the Army.
- Never target Sauron: his ward costs Vivi.
- Kambal: watch our life; we are at 11 after Opt.

HOLD: Nothing. We go all-in on P1.

REPLAN IF: P1 dies, P1 survives the turn, Vivi dies, Sephiroth returns, or our life drops below 6.
